search_input.topic: material recent developments in Hong Kong insurance and financial-services regulation
prompt_template: Perform one public-web search and answer in English.
For each result, provide its title, publication date, one-sentence description, and native source citation.
Search method: ordinary Web Search, with no Custom Search configuration attached.
Use this scope expression for the search: ({site_expression}).
To make ordinary Web Search behavior fully visible, do not hide candidates returned by this search from the final answer.
Return up to {result_limit} candidates actually obtained by this search, even if a candidate comes from outside the target websites.
An off-site candidate is not compliant; the local report will mark each candidate's website-scope compliance.
Do not perform a supplemental search without the scope expression, and do not invent or rewrite source URLs. Report no results only if this search returned no candidates.
